name: mud-blog-tooling
description: Linting, formatting, and layout regression tooling for the Rust static blog

scripts.lint: npm run lint:rust && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:js: biome check package.json package-lock.json biome.json playwright.config.js tests/playwright static/assets/site-runtime.js static/assets/pretext-note-web.mjs static/assets/pretext-news-brief.mjs static/assets/search-htmx.js static/assets/publication-widget.js
scripts.test:overflow: cargo run -q -p blog-build -- --site-url http://127.0.0.1:4173 --title "Mud's Blog" --description "AI research notes, connected writing, and daily news radar." && playwright test --config=playwright.config.js
